abilities.name: Ogre Hide
abilities.text: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.

abilities.name: Surging Fist
abilities.text: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46 damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

abilities.name: Consuming Blaze
abilities.text: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150 damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40 when an enemy is Ignited.

abilities.name: Rune Bomb
abilities.text: Roll a bomb dealing 91 damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 210 damage in an area.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.text: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 damage.

abilities.name: Hammer of Twilight
abilities.text:
Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

1.name: Consuming Fire
1.text: Consuming Blaze restores 75 more Health when a Hero is Ignited.

1.name: Calloused Hide
1.text: While under 50% maximum Health, Cho gains 15% increased Movement Speed and healing received.

1.name: The Will of Cho
1.text:
Quest: Killing enemy Minions grants 1 stack of The Will of Cho, and Hero takedowns grant 10 stacks. Gain 1 Armor for every 30 stacks of The Will of Cho, up to a maximum of 10 Armor.

This Armor bonus stacks with Ogre Hide.

4.name: Uppercut
4.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Surging Fist deals additional damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their max Health and reduces the cooldown of Surging Fist by 5 seconds.

4.name: Rollback
4.text: Rune Bomb rolls back to Cho, damaging enemies in its path.

4.name: Seared Flesh
4.text: Each consecutive Basic Attack to enemy Heroes deals 20% more damage, to a maximum of 60% damage. This bonus lasts 5 seconds or until a non-Heroic enemy is attacked.

7.name: Power Surge
7.text: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Surging Fist are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Gain 15% Movement Speed while charging Surging Fist and for 2.5 seconds after casting the Ability.

7.name: Firestarter
7.text:
Basic Attacks against ignited Heroes decreases the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 1.5 second.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Consuming Blaze by 3 seconds.

7.name: Enraged Regeneration
7.text: Each time Cho hits an enemy Hero with an Ability or Basic Attack, he heals for 60 over 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Gall's Dread Orb receive 35% less healing for 2 seconds.

10.name: Hammer of Twilight
10.text:
Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

10.name: Upheaval
10.text: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 damage.

13.name: Surging Dash
13.text: While Channeling Surging Fist, Cho heals for 150 Health per second.

13.name: Twilight Veil
13.text: Activate to increase the Armor bonus of Ogre Hide to 75 for 4 seconds. If cast while Ogre Rage is active, it instantly swaps to Ogre Hide.

13.name: Molten Block
13.text: Activate to enter Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds, damaging nearby enemies for 92 damage per second.

16.name: Frenzied Fists
16.text: Gain 75% Attack Speed for 5 seconds after using Surging Fist.

16.name: Runic Feedback
16.text: Gall's Runic Blast reduces Cho's Rune Bomb cooldown by 1 second per enemy hit, and 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

16.name: Runed Gauntlet
16.text: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Cho and Gall's Heroic Abilities by 6%.

20.name: C'Thun's Gift
20.text: Cho's Basic Attack becomes ranged and Slows targets by 20% for 2 seconds.

20.name: Favor of the Old Gods
20.text: Upheaval Roots enemy Heroes for 2 seconds.

20.name: Fuel for the Flame
20.text: Basic Attacks against enemies cause them to explode, dealing 21 damage to them and 45 damage to nearby enemies. This damage is doubled against enemy Heroes.

20.name: Hour of Twilight
20.text: Decreases Cho'gall's death timer by 50%.
